summary: Implemented P33-T5: Multi-day drift audit tool. Created back/tools/audit_drift.py as a pure-observer CLI that runs N simulated days via the existing advance_day pathway and detects monotonic drift, unbounded growth, saturation/floor lock, and residual stacking across all 13 tracked dimensions (7 AgentState + 6 AgentGrowth fields). Created back/tests/test_p33_t5_drift_audit.py with 44 tests covering all detection functions (unit), the dimension-verdict builder, the residual-verdict builder, and a class-scoped end-to-end 30-day run that validates JSON structure. All 44 new tests pass; full suite of 1061 tests passes with no regressions.

back/tools/audit_drift.py.description: Drift audit CLI. Key functions: reset_to_seed, extract_state_values, extract_growth_values, extract_residual_info (pure data extraction), detect_monotonic_drift, detect_unbounded_growth, detect_saturation_lock, detect_residual_stacking (pure drift-detection), build_dimension_verdict, build_residual_verdict (verdict builders), run_drift_audit (simulation + detection loop, callable from tests), main (CLI entry point). Output goes to back/tools/audit_outputs/drift_{label}.json. Accepts --days, --label, --monotonic-window, --unbounded-threshold, --saturation-ceiling, --saturation-floor, --saturation-lock-window, --residual-max-count, --residual-monotone-window.

back/tests/test_p33_t5_drift_audit.py.description: Test classes: TestDetectMonotonicDrift (8 tests), TestDetectUnboundedGrowth (6 tests), TestDetectSaturationLock (6 tests), TestDetectResidualStacking (8 tests), TestBuildDimensionVerdict (4 tests), TestEndToEndAudit (8 tests, class-scoped fixture runs 30-day backbone simulation once), TestBuildResidualVerdict (3 tests). Covers all acceptance criteria including synthetic trajectory checks and full JSON-structure validation.
